wins.text: Q3 revenue of $13.7B came in above the high end of guidance range, up 6% sequentially — fourth consecutive quarter of revenue above guidance
Non-GAAP gross margin of 40%, 4 percentage points better than guidance on higher revenue, favorable mix and lower inventory reserves
Q3 EPS of $0.23 vs. guidance of breakeven, driven by higher revenue, stronger gross margins and cost discipline
Secured ~$20B of cash in 2025 including $5.7B from U.S. government, $2B from SoftBank, $4.3B from Altera closure, $900M from Mobileye stake sale; exited Q3 with $30.9B cash and short-term investments
CCG revenue of $8.5B, up 8% QoQ, above expectations; client consumption TAM expected to approach 290M units in 2025, fastest TAM growth since 2021

risks.text: Q4 gross margin guided to ~36.5%, down sequentially due to product mix, higher costs from first Panther Lake (Core Ultra 3) shipments and Altera deconsolidation
Capacity constraints on Intel 10 and Intel 7 limiting ability to fully meet demand; supply tightness expected to persist into 2026 and may peak in Q1
Intel Foundry operating loss of $2.3B in Q3; 18A yields adequate but not yet at levels needed to drive appropriate margins — full cost-structure improvement expected to take through end of 2026
DCAI competitive position remains challenged; CFO acknowledged Intel lacks right cost structure and competitiveness in data center to command appropriate margins
Altera deconsolidation removes an accretive gross margin contributor, creating a ~1 point of margin headwind in 2026

guidance_items.detail: Q4 revenue guided to $12.8B–$13.8B ($13.3B midpoint); adjusting for Altera deconsolidation, roughly flat QoQ vs. Q3's $13.7B
Q4 non-GAAP gross margin guided to ~36.5%, down from 40% in Q3 due to product mix, Panther Lake ramp costs and Altera deconsolidation
Q4 non-GAAP EPS guided to $0.08, down from $0.23 in Q3
2025 gross CapEx still expected at ~$18B; >$27B to be deployed in 2025 vs. $17B in 2024
DCAI expected up strongly sequentially in Q4 as wafer capacity prioritized for server shipments; CCG expected down modestly

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Timing and materiality of NVIDIA NVLink Fusion product roadmap — management did not proactively detail product timelines or revenue impact in prepared remarks
Diamond Rapids / Coral Rapids data center CPU roadmap update — no specific server roadmap milestones mentioned in prepared remarks
18A yield trajectory and its specific impact on gross margin normalization — prepared remarks cited progress but did not quantify yield levels or margin recovery timeline
